verification.notes: Draft, not reviewed by an NCDC or UNEB officer. Confirmed from fetched sources: the competency-based lower secondary curriculum began with S1 in 2020; UNEB assesses a school-based project in S3 against a checklist of competences and indicators. NOT confirmed (UNEB's live site was unreachable and the NCDC lower secondary assessment framework was not retrieved): UNEB's current UCE reporting format and achievement levels, the weight of continuous assessment and project work against the end-of-cycle examination, the subject list and any national subject codes (the legacy UCE codes of 2016 do not apply to the new curriculum, so national_code is null), and compulsory/elective combination rules. The A-E scale and the 20/80 split are school-overridable defaults for internal reports; they are not UNEB's grading. No UCE aggregate is modelled.
